scene:
Three areas read left to right, separated by generous space and thin vertical rules. Do not write any zone names or headings.

On the left, the record kept during the work: a large clipboard with a sheet labelled DAY-100 RECORD at its top. On the sheet, four rows, each with a small icon on the left and its label on the right, top to bottom: a stopwatch, BASELINE 80 HOURS; a rubber stamp, €180K COMMITTED; an open delivery box, €90K RECEIVED; a stopwatch with a small down arrow, RESULT 62 HOURS. A thick arrow leads right from the clipboard into the middle area.

In the middle, sorting the open obligations: four open-top sorting bins in a two-by-two grid, each with one object inside and its label on the front: a rolled scroll wrapped in a chain with a padlock, BINDING; a stack of coins beside a small unbuilt gear, FUNDED WORK; a cracked umbrella held open by a hand, ACCEPTED RISK; a calendar page beside a small globe, OPTIONS: DAY 190.

On the right, top half, who receives the cash: two small flow diagrams stacked vertically. Upper: a fresh stack of share certificates with a thick teal arrow of coins flowing into an office building; label NEW SHARES: COMPANY GETS CASH. Lower: a seller figure on the LEFT hands an older stack of share certificates across to a buyer figure on the RIGHT (thin navy arrow pointing right, above); a thick ochre arrow of coins starts at the buyer on the right and points LEFT, ending at the seller; label OLD SHARES: SELLER GETS CASH. On the right, bottom half, the accepted handover: a woman in a blazer and a second woman, side by side at a desk, both signing a folder that also appears on the clipboard, with a pen and a check mark; label SIGNED AT DAY 130.

Share certificates are drawn as ornate framed blank certificates with a ribbon seal and NO words on them. Certificates, forms, calendar, folder and clipboard rows carry no writing other than the listed labels; the calendar page is blank. TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: DAY-100 RECORD, BASELINE 80 HOURS, €180K COMMITTED, €90K RECEIVED, RESULT 62 HOURS, BINDING, FUNDED WORK, ACCEPTED RISK, OPTIONS: DAY 190, NEW SHARES: COMPANY GETS CASH, OLD SHARES: SELLER GETS CASH, SIGNED AT DAY 130. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A day-100 record lists an 80-hour baseline, €180,000 committed, €90,000 of work received and a 62-hour result; open obligations are sorted into four bins, binding, funded work, accepted risk and options due at day 190; two cash flows show new shares paying the company and old shares paying the seller; two leaders sign the handover at day 130.
caption: Keep the record during the work, sort what is still open, know who receives the cash, and get the handover signed.
